name: Reef Shark
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 12. No languages.
appearance: A slender, 6- to 10-ft. shark with a slate-gray back, pale belly, pointed snout, and dark fin tips.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), p. 151, Reef Shark.
sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. When the shark attacks a creature, it has advantage if an ally within 5 ft. of that creature is not incapacitated.
Water Breathing. The shark breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: Check the ally’s distance to the target for Pack Tactics. The Reef Shark has a 40-ft. swim speed and no walking movement.

name: Scorpion
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 9. No listed skills or languages.
appearance: A small ochre scorpion with two compact pincers, eight walking legs, and a hooked stinger on a raised tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), p. 152, Scorpion.
sections.Actions: Sting. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The creature makes a DC 9 Constitution save and takes 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failure, or half on a success.
sections.At the table: The save affects only the poison damage. The sting applies no poisoned condition.
